question: What happens to age-related death through abstention from eating by day?
premises: A future departure or overcoming is stated.
inference: Through abstention from eating by day, age-related death will be overcome.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is interpretive; it may mean death will depart.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death from old age.
